run_protoc_compiler: run the protocol buffer compiler with command line arguments to generate Python code from proto files
load_proto_module: load a dynamically generated protobuf module from a .proto file path using the _protos function
load_grpc_service: load a dynamically generated gRPC service stub module from a .proto file path using the _services function
load_protos_and_services: load both protobuf and gRPC service modules together from a single .proto file path
review_ProtoLoader: review the ProtoLoader class that dynamically generates and executes Python code from protobuf definitions
